summary: The diff implements all four requirements. REQ-1 is addressed in backend/main.mo with a resultsStore, Result/MarketResults types, and a getResults query. REQ-2 is addressed in MarketCard.tsx and MarketLobby.tsx showing latest results or 'Result Awaited'. REQ-3 is addressed with the new Results.tsx page and the /results route in App.tsx plus the navigation link in Layout.tsx. REQ-4 is addressed with the new useGameResultsQueries.ts hook polling every 30 seconds. All acceptance criteria appear satisfied based on the diff evidence.
